title: GO Command Center Signed Evidence V1
description: The machine-verifiable result of a signed Task. Published by the Hong Kong Agent to chenzhenxi1-sudo/go-control-evidence under evidence/<task_id>-<nonce>.json. Evidence is not a log: it binds identity, action, environment, time window and result under an Ed25519 signature that the Command Center verifies with the living Hong Kong evidence key.

failure.description: present only when status is not SUCCESS; the closed failure semantics are described in contracts/failure_evidence_v1.schema.json

signature.description: Ed25519, base64. Verifies against /etc/go-hk-agent/keys/evidence-signing.pub, published as identity/keys/hk-evidence-signing.pub.

x-go-notes: Two generations exist on the control bus. completed_at/executor_result/gate_results is current; finished_at/result is legacy. A projection must normalise both and must not silently drop either.

CC V1-02: a Task whose claimed execution attempt fails now publishes a signed FAILED record, bound to the original task_id, nonce, action_id and environment and written to the same evidence/<task_id>-<nonce>.json path. Its closed semantics are in contracts/failure_evidence_v1.schema.json.

A Task rejected BEFORE its attempt was claimed still publishes nothing, because a Task whose own signature never verified must never be able to cause a write. Absence of Evidence therefore means 'never picked up or never authenticated', which is a different statement from 'nothing happened'.

A failure record authorizes nothing: retry_permitted, replay_authorized and authorizes_any_action are always false, and the one-attempt rule is enforced by the agent ledger rather than by this document.
TEST_PR Evidence must carry application_health_proven=false and deployment_performed=false. It proves an isolated offline build, not a deployment.
